function.name: create_todo
function.description: Add a plain-text todo at the top of one shared Surface. For a section heading, start the text with exact '# ' (hash and space); it remains an ordinary ordered todo without a checkbox. Explicitly supply authorUserId as a local Happy user ID, or null for no attribution; only null is allowed in standalone mode. The author is immutable and separate from the revision's audit actor. This never creates a chat or joins anyone to the Surface.
